title: 3 PLACES
IN TURKEY
TOURISTS MISS

hook.say: Three places in Turkey that most tourists never see. Number one hides one of the world's first stock exchanges.

outro.say: Which hidden place in Turkey should we show next? Comment below!

outroLines: WHICH PLACE SHOULD WE SHOW NEXT?

items.say: Number three: Ah-soss, on a cliff above the Aegean. This Temple of Athena has stood here since 530 BC.
items.cap: Number three: Assos, on a cliff above the Aegean. This Temple of Athena has stood here since 530 BC.

items.say: More than 2300 years ago, a philosopher named Aristotle moved in, and opened a school.
items.cap: More than 2,300 years ago, a philosopher named Aristotle moved in, and opened a school.

items.say: Number two: the Saffron Monastery, near Mar-deen. Founded in the year 493, on top of a far older temple to the sun.
items.cap: Number two: the Saffron Monastery, near Mardin. Founded in the year 493, on top of a far older temple to the sun.

items.say: For more than 750 years, it was the seat of the Syriac Orthodox patriarch. Services here are still held in Syriac, a form of Aramaic.
items.cap: For more than 750 years, it was the seat of the Syriac Orthodox patriarch. Services here are still held in Syriac, a form of Aramaic.

items.say: And number one: Eye-zah-noy. One of the best preserved temples of Zeus anywhere in the world, with a hidden vaulted chamber underneath.
items.cap: And number one: Aizanoi. One of the best preserved temples of Zeus anywhere in the world, with a hidden vaulted chamber underneath.

items.say: In its market, prices fixed by a Roman emperor in 301 AD are still carved in stone. UNESCO calls it one of the world's first stock exchanges.
